mutations.name: Treat READY as permission
mutations.operator: Replace purpose-specific authority resolution with decision == READY.
mutations.activation_probe: A READY case with ABSENT permission reaches the mutated allow branch.

mutations.name: Remove the producer purpose
mutations.operator: Delete purpose from the Context envelope before consumer validation.
mutations.activation_probe: The received envelope has no purpose member.

mutations.name: Substitute the requested purpose
mutations.operator: Rewrite the envelope purpose to match the proposed effect after integrity validation.
mutations.activation_probe: The scope comparator receives a purpose not present in the verified envelope.

mutations.name: Ignore an envelope digest mismatch
mutations.operator: Return integrity pass without comparing the canonical envelope digest.
mutations.activation_probe: The modified-digest fixture advances beyond integrity validation.

mutations.name: Ignore the expiry boundary
mutations.operator: Treat every schema-valid Context envelope as temporally current.
mutations.activation_probe: The expired READY fixture advances beyond freshness validation.

mutations.name: Suppress producer limitations
mutations.operator: Drop limitations, trust issues, and disagreements from the consumer record and receipt.
mutations.activation_probe: A case with a nonempty limitation emits a receipt with no limitation evidence.

mutations.name: Coerce stale Context to verified
mutations.operator: Replace a stale or invalid trust state with verified before Authority evaluation.
mutations.activation_probe: The stale Context fixture enters Authority evaluation as verified.

mutations.name: Ignore revoked permission
mutations.operator: Treat a revoked permission record as granted when Context is READY.
mutations.activation_probe: The revoked-permission fixture reaches the mutated allow branch.

mutations.name: Hide an interface hard failure in an aggregate pass
mutations.operator: Compute one weighted score that reports pass despite a failed interface dimension.
mutations.activation_probe: The report contains a passing aggregate while a constituent dimension is FAIL.

mutations.name: Refuse an independent authorized action
mutations.operator: Convert federated-route rejection into a global refusal without evaluating the independent path.
mutations.activation_probe: The independent-path fixture returns no effect despite direct evidence and authority.
